script: A part-time store usually needs ten to fifteen hours a week in the first months. Choose two fixed work sessions and protect them like a job. Your first goal is learning, not a salary. Expect learning in the first month, testing in months two to four, and stability later. Think like a tester, not a gambler. Keep numbers, not feelings. Set a maximum loss you can afford, and never borrow money to fund ads.
glossary: dropshipping, supplier, ROAS, CPA, stop-loss, Shopify
